jobs.title: Product Manager (Models)
jobs.description:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

 

About the Role

We are hiring a Model Product Manager to own charters for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and model evaluation pipelines. You will work closely with research and engineering teams to define roadmaps, run training and evaluation cycles, and ship models that directly improve product experience and reliability.

 

What You'll Do

• Define and drive roadmaps for ASR, TTS, and evaluation systems.

• Partner with engineering and research teams on data collection, training cycles, and model release planning.

• Set up and own evaluation frameworks and quality metrics covering accuracy, latency, MOS, and robustness.

• Run structured experiments — offline tests, A/Bs, and human evaluations — to quantify model improvements.

• Ensure scalable deployment and monitoring of models in collaboration with infra and data teams.

• Translate user and business needs into measurable model goals.

• Communicate priorities, timelines, and trade-offs clearly across stakeholders.

 

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years of experience building AI, applied AI, ML products, or model training pipelines.

• Familiarity with the model lifecycle: training, fine-tuning, deployment, and monitoring.

• Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across research, engineering, and product teams.

 

Bonus Points

• Exposure to speech technologies (ASR, TTS) or evaluation pipelines.

• Experience with quality metrics such as WER, CER, MOS, or latency tracking.

• Hands-on familiarity with SQL, Python, or ML toolkits.

 

Why Sarvam?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

• Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

• High ownership and high impact, from day one

• Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems

• You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

jobs.description:

About the Role

Sarvam is our on-device AI product line — purpose-built for enterprise deployments where data sovereignty, low latency, and offline reliability are non-negotiable. We're looking for a Product Manager who understands enterprise AI deeply: the IT admin personas, the procurement cycles, the compliance requirements, and the day-to-day friction that determines whether an AI tool gets embedded into workflows or quietly abandoned.

You'll own the product roadmap for drive B2B GTM alignment, and run iterative experiments to build stickiness in enterprise workflows. You'll work closely with engineering, sales, and customer success to define what enterprise-grade AI looks like when it runs on-device, at the edge, and inside a customer's own security perimeter.

You will co-own as a Full Stack product builder the most ambitious on-device AI problem in India building sovereign models that run at the silicon level across devices. You will be embedded with silicon partners like Qualcomm, Intel, HP, Apple, NVIDIA etc turning research breakthroughs into production-grade optimisations that serve 1.5b indians at http://1.at min latency. You will architect the Product motion from tuning to agentic orchestration and client deployment, this is not a feature team, it is a platform-defining role. If you want to build the infrastructure layer that makes AI truly accessible across every laptop, phone, glasses and car in India, please apply!





What You'll Do

• Own the product roadmap for Sarvam, from on-device inference to enterprise deployment and fleet management

• Define and prioritise features for IT admin personas — MDM integration, device provisioning, policy enforcement, and enterprise authentication (including Microsoft ecosystem)

• Drive B2B GTM alignment by working with sales and customer success to translate customer pain points into product requirements

• Run iterative experiments in enterprise deployments to identify and improve workflow stickiness and adoption

• Design and ship features for multi-tenant SaaS architecture, including tenant isolation, access controls, and admin tooling

• Define requirements for HITL (human-in-the-loop) and agentic workflows, ensuring enterprise-grade reliability and auditability

• Experience running structured product experiments and using data to drive roadmap decisions in enterprise contexts

• Ability to work directly with IT admin and enterprise buyer personas — understanding their workflows, constraints, and decision criteria

• Comfort with technical depth: APIs, security and compliance requirements, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture

• Background in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering preferred



Bonus Points

• Experience with HITL workflows or agentic AI product design

• Prior exposure to data residency, sovereign cloud, or on-premise enterprise AI deployments

jobs.description:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

About the Role

We're building India's sovereign AI platform across API, Agents, Creator Studio, and consumer products. Revenue is no longer a side conversation. It's the conversation. We need a PM who owns the full monetization stack: how we price, how we bill, how we keep users paying, and how we win them back when they don't.

 

This role sits at the intersection of pricing strategy, billing infrastructure, and lifecycle marketing. You'll work closely with platform, growth, and product teams to turn one-time users into repeat payers and repeat payers into long-term revenue.

What You’ll Do

 - Plans, pricing, and packaging. Design the pricing architecture across our products. Build tiers that map to user willingness to pay. Run pricing experiments. Decide what's free, what's metered, what's locked behind a plan.

 - Subscription and billing systems. Own the metering, billing, invoicing, and expiry logic. Work with platform engineering on the wallet, coupons, GST, Razorpay/UPI flows, and renewal mechanics. Make sure the plumbing scales as we add products.

 - Retention and churn. Build the playbook for keeping users. Diagnose where they drop off. Ship in-product interventions (paywalls, nudges, downgrade flows, win-back offers) and off-product ones (lifecycle email, WhatsApp, payment recovery). Reduce involuntary churn from failed payments.

 - First-time vs repeat monetization. Design distinct strategies for converting first-time payers and growing repeat purchase value. These are different problems. We expect you to treat them that way.

 - Loyalty and affiliate programs. Stand up loyalty mechanics that move the needle on LTV. Build affiliate and partnership models where they make sense for our distribution.

What We’re Looking For

 - 5+ years in product management with at least 2-3 years owning monetization, subscriptions, or growth at a startup

 - You've shipped pricing changes and lived with the results. You know what worked and what blew up

 - Deep working knowledge of metering, billing, plans, pricing, subscriptions, expiry, and coupons. You've debated Lago vs Orb vs Stripe Billing and have opinions

 - You've reduced churn before and can talk specifics: cohorts, triggers, interventions, win-back rates

 - You understand both on-app interventions (paywalls, upsells, downgrade flows) and off-app interventions (lifecycle messaging, payment retries, dunning)

 - Clear thinker on first-time payer conversion vs repeat purchase economics. You don't conflate the two

 - Numbers at your fingertips. You don't open a deck without the latest cohort data. ARPU, LTV, payback, retention curves, dunning recovery rates: you live in these dashboards and pull SQL yourself when you need to

Why this role?

 - Real ownership. You won't be one of ten PMs fighting over a roadmap slot. You own monetization across the company. The pricing page, the billing stack, the retention playbook: yours to shape.

 - Move metrics at scale. Sarvam's products touch the entire Indian AI ecosystem. Our products span across offering models, APIs, applications.

 - The best product team you'll work with. Sharp operators from the best product orgs in India. People who ship weekly, argue hard, and ship harder. You'll be pushed and you'll grow fast.

 - AI at the frontier. You'll sit next to researchers building India's foundation models. Access to the latest cutting-edge models, internal research, and a team that genuinely understands how this technology works.

 - Independence to bet big. If you have a thesis on pricing, loyalty, or a new monetization motion, bring it. We give PMs room to run their own experiments and own the outcomes, good or bad.

 - The standard startup perks. Competitive cash, meaningful equity, top-tier health insurance, great Bangalore office. And if you win internal hackathons, you get a PS5.

Why Sarvam?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

 - Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

 - High ownership and high impact, from day one

 - Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems

 - You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

jobs.description:
Product · Bengaluru · Full Time · On-Site




ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Sarvam Studio is our media platform — spanning AI dubbing, live translation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and audiobook & podcast generation, powered by a shared foundation of voice cloning, stem separation and music generation. Its users range from individual creators to media houses to large broadcasters and streaming platforms.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who knows the media and entertainment industry from the inside — someone who has built products for OTT, broadcast, streaming, or media-tech platforms and understands how content actually gets made, localized, distributed, and monetized. You'll own how Studio serves the media industry: what a dubbing pipeline needs to look like for a broadcaster running hundreds of hours of content a month, what "broadcast quality" means for AI-generated voice, and how AI reshapes the economics of content creation and localization.

This is a builder's role, not a strategy-deck role. You'll talk to studios, broadcasters, and creators constantly, ship product every week, and get deep into how our voice and media models behave in production.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the Studio product roadmap for media & entertainment customers end-to-end — from discovery with broadcasters, OTT platforms, and content studios, to specs, shipping, and measuring outcomes

 - Translate media workflows into product: content ingestion, dubbing and localization pipelines, QC and human-in-the-loop review, delivery formats, and rights/compliance requirements that broadcast and streaming customers demand

 - Define what "good" means for AI-generated media — voice quality, lip-sync, emotional nuance, translation fidelity — and build the eval pipelines and feedback loops that hold the product to it

 - Get into the details of how AI systems behave in production: model selection, prompt and pipeline design, latency and cost budgets, failure modes

 - Work with the GTM team on pricing, packaging, and positioning for media segments — from per-minute creator pricing to enterprise localization contracts

 - Be the voice of the media customer internally: relay precise product and model feedback (dubbing failures, audio artefacts, translation misses) to research, and close the loop with customers

 - Track the AI-in-media landscape — content creation, localization, and playout platforms — and bring a sharp point of view on where Studio should build, partner, or pass

 - Ship product every week, not plans


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5–10 years of product management experience, with real products shipped at meaningful scale

 - Strong preference for experience in media & entertainment — Video & Content first platforms OTT/streaming platforms (Prime Video, JioHotstar, Zee5, SonyLIV), broadcasters, studios, or media-tech/content-supply-chain companies (Adobe, Amagi, Prime Focus, or similar)

 - Deep understanding of the content lifecycle: how content is produced, transformed (dubbing, subtitling), packaged, distributed, and monetized across broadcast and streaming

 - Hands-on familiarity with generative AI in content workflows — voice synthesis, dubbing, video/audio generation — and clear thinking on quality vs. cost vs. speed trade-offs

 - Strong data skills: comfortable writing SQL, setting up funnels, and defining success metrics that matter (not vanity numbers)

 - Strong product thinking: you start with the customer's problem, structure vague problem spaces, and ship v1 without over-engineering

 - High ownership, high agency: you don't wait for permission, and you've stayed up to fix something because you couldn't let it stay broken

 - Clear communicator — equally effective with a dubbing director, an enterprise buyer, and a research engineer


BONUS POINTS

 - You've shipped an AI-powered media product — content generation, dubbing, localization, voice, or video generation — that real customers used in production

 - You've worked with media supply chain, playout, or content operations platforms and understand broadcast-grade quality and delivery standards

 - You know what good dubbing sounds like — you can hear the difference between passable and broadcast-ready

 - Experience with usage-based pricing and enterprise media contracts

 - You've built agents or AI workflows yourself and have opinions on when to use them

jobs.title: Product Manager - Chanakya
jobs.description:
About team: 

Chanakya is Sarvam AI's specialised, self-contained vertical for national security and institutions of national importance. It carries its own pricing, business, product, engineering, custom-model and vendor functions under one roof — a complete unit built to solve the most complex problems in the strategic sector: the three armed forces, intelligence agencies, financial regulators, and institutions of national importance such as central ministries and national policy bodies.

What we deploy here must be at strategic parity or higher — anything less is a national-security risk. That standard is the reason Chanakya is a small, exceptionally high-performing team inside Sarvam, and the reason we are deliberate about who joins it.

Why this is one of the most consequential seats in Indian AI

01 — NATIONAL IMPACT

You sit where it all gets decided.

These systems are deployed inside the institutions that safeguard the country. The potential for national impact is not abstract — it is at the core of how the strategic sector reasons, decides, and acts. Few roles anywhere in Indian technology carry this weight.

02 — UNPARALLELED LEARNING

Full-stack, end to end — nowhere else does this exist.

Every deployment runs the entire stack: understanding a customer's real requirement, architecting and customising the stack for it, and where needed building and fine-tuning models, shaping training data, and inventing data representations for extraordinarily complex data, workflows and applications. You touch nearly the whole arc of the work. This experience sets you apart — whether you go on to found a company, or become a business or technology leader in the years ahead, at Sarvam or beyond.

03 — A PATH TO LEADERSHIP

These are leadership seats in the making.

Chanakya's functions are being built out now. We are looking for people who will grow into the leaders of these emerging functions — every one of these roles is a route to leading a part of the vertical, not just filling it.

Where we are. This is not a leap into the unknown. Chanakya has already achieved product–market fit to a meaningful degree, has significant revenue booked, and has large strategic projects officially underway. Things are structured and going well.

The opportunity. This is a genuine zero-to-one journey — but one taken within the reach, talent and standing of a company like Sarvam. You get the ambition and ownership of building something new, backed by the full weight of Sarvam's capability and presence. The golden opportunity: to help build out and lead the emerging functions of Chanakya, with a clear growth path ahead. 

 

Product Manager (4–8 years)

Zero-to-one builders for a next-generation defence decision-support product.

We are building a next-generation decision-support product for defence users and need product leaders who have genuinely taken something from zero to one — conceived, built, and shipped a product to real users, not managed a roadmap on an established one.

• A hands-on, prototyping instinct — comfortable putting something rough in front of users quickly.

•Stayed in the line of building tech products; strong AI-first instinct — reasoning about what

models make newly possible.

•Comfortable with ambiguity, senior institutional users, air-gapped deployments, and frequent

travel to client sites. Much of the product definition will be theirs to make.

 

The bar. Across every one of these roles, we are looking for people who want to change the world and build something of national consequence — and who will grow into the leaders of Chanakya's verticals. If that is you, the ceiling here is set only by your ambition.

Base: Delhi NCR, with travel across India. All roles involve working inside restricted environments and travelling to client sites at short notice.
